title: How a 22 year old built a million dollar app with AI

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The "how" is clear—AI tools like AutoML and no-code platforms let anyone build apps fast, bypassing years of traditional development.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But the "a" matters—without a unique angle or user need, even the best tech can't create value. A million-dollar app isn’t just about tools.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Look at apps like Jasper and Copy.ai—they leveraged AI protocols to scale instantly, proving the "how" is what drives real success.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: You can have the best tech, but without a specific audience or problem, you're just building a toy. The "a" defines impact.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The "how" delivers the "a"—AI makes the impossible possible, turning ideas into scalable, profitable apps in record time.
